_note: Co-scholastic subjects for the assessment-app report card (LKG/SKG/Class I/Class II). Unlike academic subjects these are NOT criteria-scored fortnightly — they carry a single letter grade per student per term, matching the Class III-X convention in Sfs-report-card. They are displayed in their own section and are deliberately excluded from the academic overall average.

subjects._why: Class I/II only. LKG and SKG already carry ART 'Arts/Colouring' as a full academic subject in subjects.json — 14 criteria, criteria-scored fortnightly, counted in the overall average. Listing it here too put two Arts marks on two different scales on the same kindergarten card. Do not add LKG/SKG back without first removing ART from subjects.json.
subjects.label: Arts & Craft
